example.title: Steamship Authority ferry terminal, Woods Hole

brief: A ferry terminal on the harbour: low grey-shingled terminal buildings with white trim, a gabled roof, transfer bridges and slips where a big white island ferry is berthed. One photo. (Terminal rebuilt 2020s; Nantucket ferries sail from here and Hyannis.) Older than 1970: the historic Charleston civic core (the town's model) is 18th-19th-century. Foundations deeper than needed (spec rule 4).
